description: This file contains Swagger representations of API models and responses for the 'Groups' API resource in the Fineract project, including nested classes for request and response schemas related to group management.

classes.name: GetGroupsTemplateResponse
classes.description: Response schema for retrieving a template for creating or editing groups, including office, staff, client options, and datatables.

classes.name: GetGroupsResponse
classes.description: Schema for listing groups with pagination and status information.

classes.name: GetGroupsGroupIdResponse
classes.description: Detailed information about a specific group, including timeline and hierarchy.

classes.name: PostGroupsRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new group, specifying office ID, name, and active status.

classes.name: PostGroupsResponse
classes.description: Response after creating a group, indicating the new group's ID and related resource.

classes.name: DeleteGroupsGroupIdResponse
classes.description: Response schema for deleting a group, including identifiers.

classes.name: PostGroupsGroupIdCommandUnassignStaffRequest
classes.description: Request schema for unassigning staff from a group.

classes.name: PostGroupsGroupIdCommandUnassignStaffResponse
classes.description: Response schema after unassigning staff, including change details.

classes.name: PutGroupsGroupIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating group details, such as name.

classes.name: PutGroupsGroupIdResponse
classes.description: Response after updating a group, showing changes made.

classes.name: GetGroupsGroupIdAccountsResponse
classes.description: Details about the accounts associated with a group, including loan, savings, and member accounts.

classes.name: PostGroupsGroupIdRequest
classes.description: Request schema for attaching clients to a group.

classes.name: PostGroupsGroupIdResponse
classes.description: Response after attaching clients to a group.
